edges.reason: transferAndCall transfers tokens then calls tokenFallback on the user-supplied recipient, allowing an attacker contract to re-enter before state settles
msg.sender is forwarded as the _sender argument of the external tokenFallback call
transferAndCall invokes transfer(recipient, amount)
recipient parameter is zero-checked and used as the callback target
amount parameter drives the balance check and the transfer
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to tokenFallback
pause requires hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) making msg.sender the access-control gate
unpause requires hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) making msg.sender the access-control gate
transferERCToken requires hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) before moving foreign tokens
transferERCToken performs an external IERC20Upgradeable(tokenContractAddress).transfer call
tokenContractAddress parameter selects the arbitrary external call target
permit enforces require(block.timestamp <= deadline), creating a timestamp dependency
deadline parameter is compared directly against block.timestamp
permit calls ECDSAUpgradeable.recover which executes ecrecover
signer local variable is assigned the recovered address
owner parameter is compared against the recovered signer
structHash is hashed into the digest that is passed to recover
permit calls _approve which writes the _allowances mapping
ifAdmin modifier compares msg.sender with _admin() before executing changeAdmin
changeAdmin writes the ADMIN_SLOT storage variable
upgradeToAndCall is guarded by the ifAdmin modifier keyed on msg.sender
upgradeToAndCall performs a delegatecall to newImplementation with arbitrary data
newImplementation parameter is the target of the delegatecall
_upgradeTo writes the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT storage variable
initialize delegatecalls _data to _logic
_logic parameter is the target of the initialization delegatecall
_admin parameter is passed into the proxy initializer
PUNDIXTokenProxy.initialize stores _admin into ADMIN_SLOT
PUNDIXTokenProxy.initialize calls InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize
fallback delegates execution to the implementation, transferring control to external code
pause sets the _paused state variable to true
unpause sets the _paused state variable to false
_beforeTokenTransfer requires !paused() before any token move
transfer delegates to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
_transfer updates the _balances mapping
burn reduces _totalSupply through _burn
burnFrom rewrites the caller allowance in _allowances
decreasedAllowance local result is approved then used by the burn
account parameter is the source of the burned tokens
initialize grants the ADMIN_ROLE constant
initialize mints the initial supply via _mint
to parameter is the recipient of the initial mint
initialize populates role assignments in _roles
initialize assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ADMIN_ROLE to _msgSender()
amount parameter is the value burned by burn
success local variable stores the delegatecall result that upgradeToAndCall requires to be true

normalization_plan.reason: The `to` parameter only exists to supply the mint recipient inside initialize.
The tokenContractAddress parameter is the arbitrary target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
Recipient is consumed by the transfer and callback logic of transferAndCall.
Amount is only used for the balance check and the transfer inside transferAndCall.
Data is forwarded unchanged to the tokenFallback callback invoked by transferAndCall.
Owner is compared with the recovered signer inside permit.
Deadline is only consumed by the block.timestamp check in permit.
The parameter is the delegatecall target of upgradeToAndCall.
_logic is the delegatecall target of the proxy initializer.
_admin is consumed by the proxy initializer and stored into the admin slot.
Account is the burn source used by burnFrom.
Amount is the sole value burned by burn.
Signer is the local result of the ecrecover-based recovery in permit.
structHash is a permit-local intermediate that feeds the signature digest.
decreasedAllowance is a burnFrom-local value used to reset the allowance.
success is the local delegatecall result checked by upgradeToAndCall.
